title: The Kingdom S01E02

consistency.note: Genre, mood, tags, and hook all point to a tense adult religious-political drama; faith crisis is a bit stronger than the hook’s moral/political framing but does not contradict it.

recsys_usefulness.note: Would retrieve this for adult political-thriller and religious-drama viewers; generic tags and a skewed hook weaken episode-level matching.

summary: The profile correctly signals an adult political-religious thriller and is internally coherent, but the hook adds unsupported identity and relationship claims while several tags infer corruption and a faith crisis the synopsis does not state.
